text:
jin: Running structured-output evals against q4_0_anonymous model and started seeing crashes. Runner exits with code 1, validator complaining about func_call.name.

ashley: Can you paste the log?

jin: ```
EvalRunner: batch 324 failed validation
ValidatorError: func_call.name: expected string, got array
  at validateSchema (/srv/eval/validator.js:122)
Exit code: 1
```

ravi: That "func_call.name" being an array is surprising. Is that from the model or from the postprocessor?

jin: Looks like model emitted it. Failing ndjson line:

```json
{"id":"abc123","response":{"content":"...","function_call":{"name":["create_item"],"arguments":"{\"item\":\"x\"}"}}}
```

marco: We explicitly expect `function_call.name` to be a string in the schema. Schema change? Or normalize in runner?

ashley: Could quantization affect this? Tokenizer returning extra tokens that the parser turns into array? I've seen odd token boundaries with q4 profiles.

jin: Reproduces more frequently on q4_0-quantized but also seen once on fp16; so likely a model output variance, not purely quant.

qa-bot: CI: job test-eval-structured-output failed 3/20 runs. <https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4821|build 4821>

ashley: Short-term fix: normalize single-element arrays to string in eval-runner and emit telemetry metric `func_call.name.array_rate`.
Long-term: update schema to accept `string | [string]`? I'd prefer normalizing and emitting noise metric.

ravi: Also we should add a regression test with a synthetic model that returns array name, and gate the CI to rerun flaky jobs twice before failing.

jin: I'll open a PR: patch adds normalization, unit tests, and a small fuzz test that injects "function_call":{"name":["x"]} into runner inputs.

marco: Might also be a bug in eng-ml tool-adapter parser that merges function calls. I'll grep `tool-adapter` for array handling.

ashley: Repro command:
```
pytest tests/eval_structured.py::test_toolcall_batch --runs 1000 -k q4
```

jin: Plan: PR today, CI run with extended runs tomorrow, and a postmortem if we see >1% array-rate in prod telemetry. Anyone object?

ashley: :thumbsup:

ravi: no objections.

qa-bot: Created ticket RED-ML-842 for follow-up tracking.
